The '''Chad system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained at least four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Chad/Legends|Chadra]]. Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Chad (star)|Chad]]. The Chad [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was home to the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]].
